name: English SDH Preference
description: Opt-in English SDH subtitle preference; drops play-request track numbers the file does not have.
overview: Opt-in English SDH subtitle preference; drops play-request track numbers the file does not have.

versions.changelog: Play requests whose audio or subtitle index does not exist in the file (an item page left open while the file was replaced) start on the default audio and the English choice; clients that lost their capabilities in a server restart still get the subtitle command; settle-delay tests run on a fake clock.
Recognize regional English subtitle tags; 18 new regression cases.
Initial opt-in English SDH preference release.

name: Max Quality
description: Plays every video at its original quality: a client's bitrate limit no longer forces a transcode. A quality you pick during playback is respected for the rest of that video.
overview: Direct play at original quality; your mid-playback quality choice is respected

versions.changelog: Fix: 1.0.0.0 failed to load on Jellyfin 12.1 (NullReferenceException in PluginManager.CreatePluginInstance) because the plugin class derived from the non-generic BasePlugin, whose Version is never set. It now derives from BasePlugin<PluginConfiguration>.

name: Simkl Mark Sync
description: Sends movies and episodes you mark played or unplayed, and every playback Jellyfin counts as finished, to Simkl, using the official Simkl plugin's login. A removal always names its episodes, so Simkl never deletes a whole show.
overview: Send manual played / unplayed marks to Simkl

versions.changelog: Also sends every playback Jellyfin counts as finished, so a watch reaches Simkl when the official plugin misses it; optional rewatch tracking for Simkl PRO/VIP.
First release: manual played and unplayed marks of movies and episodes are sent to Simkl in batches, using the official Simkl plugin's login.

name: Simkl
description: The official Simkl scrobbler (v9) with one fix: a playback started again shortly after a stop is scrobbled. Same plugin ID as the official plugin.

versions.changelog: Official v9 plus the replay fix: a playback started again shortly after a stop is scrobbled; v9 ignored it and its final stop.
